== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Eject! Eject! (Japanese)|Eject! Eject!]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67701 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(4, 6, 452, 623)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9fc37b4b31d6da6e3ed3637edbddd26f270855f769e9fd35e9d42e942bd4bc05</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
